opacity.$description: Opacities that apply to a whole element, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).

disabled.$description: A disabled control, drawn whole at this opacity: its fill, border, label and icon together, so it keeps its shape and its variant but reads as unavailable. It sits between Apple's disabled labels (iOS's tertiary label is 30 %) and libadwaita's --disabled-opacity (50 %, 40 % in high contrast). WCAG exempts an inactive control from contrast (chapter 08).

dev.westron.usage.avoid: Colors of its own for the disabled state, or dimming the parts one by one; and something that is only secondary, which takes text.secondary and stays readable. A system control that the platform disables keeps the platform's look.
